Strict Schur inequalities 1+beta+/-t>0 hold for any h>2epsilon/lambda. Hence both F² multipliers have modulus <1. Their product fixes a lower spectral-radius bound beta, attained precisely for |t|<=2sqrt(beta); monotone t and factorization 1-3beta-2sqrt(beta)=(1-3sqrt(beta))(1+sqrt(beta)) establish the two sharp gain regimes. value.rationale: The motivating study identifies full-parameter scalar attraction numerically but proves only attraction near the flip threshold. The present calculation resolves the all-supercritical local stability question and exactly optimizes the two-step spectral rate over an unbounded learning-rate parameter, finding the structurally sharp transition at beta=1/9 and an actual reentrant slowdown. This is a motivated control of the model’s local dynamical robustness, not a gratuitous finite numerical example.
